skill.summary: Automate web browser interactions using natural language via CLI commands. Use when the user asks to browse websites, navigate web pages, extract data from websites, take screenshots, fill forms, click buttons, or interact with web applications.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the browser skill for Stagehand CLI
- Automates web browser interactions using natural language commands via CLI
- Automatically selects local Chrome or remote Browserbase environment based on configuration
- Supports commands to navigate, interact, extract data, observe elements, take screenshots, and close browser
- Includes setup instructions, troubleshooting tips, and mode comparison for local vs remote usage
